environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING action override to Count, (2) a custom rule with priority 1 that uses a RegexPatternSet matching statement on the query string component with pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d)` in BLOCK mode, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default action. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/RestrictedTaskBoundary) that denies s3:* and ssm:GetParameter, and the VPC has no NAT gateway (egress-restricted). CloudWatch Logs Insights query scheduled every 5 minutes alerting on HTTP 500 responses.

config.vpc_egress: no NAT gateway, VPC endpoints only for ECR and CloudWatch
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights alert on 5xx spike
